title: IVG Smart Max Blue Raspberry Ice Prefilled Vape Pod + Refill
description: Blue Raspberry Ice from IVG delivers a punchy Blue Raspberry flavour balanced by a streak of cool Menthol. The fruit note brings a sweet and tangy berry taste, while the icy finish sharpens the profile without overwhelming the senses. It's a bold, clean combination that fans of chilled berry blends will appreciate. Each Smart Max Prefilled Pod pack includes a 2ml pod prefilled with 20mg nicotine salt e-liquid, plus a separate 10ml refill reservoir that attaches directly to the pod. Once connected, the refill system automatically tops up the pod during use, potentially supporting up to 10,000 puffs per kit depending on usage. No refilling or coil changes required. The pod features mesh coil technology to deliver full-bodied flavour and smooth vapour with every puff. Designed exclusively for the IVG Smart Max Prefilled Pod Vape Kit, these pods are easy to install and deliver long-lasting satisfaction. How to Set Up: Remove the red stoppers from the 2ml pod. Twist and remove the red safety cap from the 10ml refill reservoir. Insert the pod into the refill and press firmly until they click together. Insert the connected pod and refill into the Smart Max device.
